cyma recta.translation: 正波纹线; 表反曲线

cymagraph.translation: n. 反曲线轮廓勾划器

cymar.definition: n. A slight covering; a scarf. See Simar.

cymarigenin.translation: [化] 磁麻配基(取自磁麻Apocynum cannabium)

cymarose.translation:
[化] 磁麻糖; 加拿大麻糖
[医] 磁麻糖, 加拿大麻糖

cymbal.definition: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a concave brass disk; makes a loud crashing sound when hit with a drumstick or when two are struck together

cymbalist.definition: n. a performer on the cymbals

cymbalom.translation: n. 钦巴龙(在匈牙利演奏吉卜赛乐曲的一种扬琴)

cymbals.definition: n a percussion instrument consisting of a concave brass disk; makes a loud crashing sound when hit with a drumstick or when two are struck together

cymbeline.translation: n. 《辛白林》(莎士比亚根据薄伽丘的故事创作的剧本)

cymbidium.definition: n any of various plants of the genus Cymbidium having narrow leaves and a long drooping cluster of numerous showy and variously colored boat-shaped flowers; extensively hybridized and cultivated as houseplants and important florists' flowers

cymbiform.definition:
a. Shaped like a boat; (Bot.) elongated and having the
   upper surface decidedly concave, as the glumes of many grasses.
cymbiform.translation:
a. 船形的, 舟状的
[医] 舟形的, 舟状的

cymbium.definition: n. A genus of marine univalve shells; the gondola.

cyme.definition: n. more or less flat-topped cluster of flowers in which the central or terminal flower opens first
cyme.translation:
n. 聚伞花序
[医] 聚щ花序

cymene.definition: n. any of three isotopes of a colorless aromatic liquid hydrocarbon occurring in the volatile oil of cumin and thyme and used in the manufacture of synthetic resins
cymene.translation:
n. 伞花烃, 异丙基苯, 甲基
[医] 对异丙基甲苯, ?花烃

cymidine.definition: n. A liquid organic base, C10H13.NH2, derived from cymene.
cymidine.translation: 伞花碱, 氨基伞花烃

cymling.definition: n squash plant having flattened round fruit with a scalloped edge; usually greenish white
cymling.translation: n. 一种白绿色扁圆之南瓜

cymogene.definition:
n. A highly volatile liquid, condensed by cold and pressure
   from the first products of the distillation of petroleum; -- used for
   producing low temperatures.
cymogene.translation:
n. 粗丁烷
[建] 粗丁烷, 近乎纯的丁烷

cymograph.definition: n scientific instrument consisting of a rotating drum holding paper on which a stylus traces a continuous record (as of breathing or blood pressure)
cymograph.translation:
n. 自记波频计, 自记波长计
[医] 记波[纹]器

cymoid.definition: a. Having the form of a cyme.

cymometer.translation:
n. 频率计, 波长计
[计] 频率计, 波长计

cymose.definition: s. having a usually flat-topped flower cluster in which the main and branch stems each end in a flower that opens before those below it or to its side

cymous.definition:
a. Having the nature of a cyme, or derived from a cyme;
   bearing, or pertaining to, a cyme or cymes.

cymric.definition: n a Celtic language of Wales
cymric.translation:
n. 威尔士之赛尔特语
a. 威尔士人[语]的

cymru.definition: n one of the four countries that make up the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland; during Roman times the region was known as Cambria

cymry.definition: n a native or resident of Wales
